definitions.gloss: highest grade; top quality; finest; premium
definitions.explanation: The very best quality or grade of something. Used for products, materials, services, and experiences.

examples.japanese: {最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: To stay at a top-quality hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This shop uses only the finest ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コレクション→コレクション：07327_korekushon⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{開|あ}けない→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: He collects the finest wines and only opens them on special occasions.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most) + ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ (high-grade, luxury). Literally "the most high-grade" — the superlative form of ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧.

USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) to describe premium products, services, or experiences. Common in advertising, product descriptions, and restaurant reviews. Can also be used as a standalone noun meaning "the highest grade."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ — finest materials/ingredients
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧ — top luxury brand
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ — top-class hotel
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — premium product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ — high-grade, upscale (without the superlative)
- {最上級|さいじょうきゅう} — superlative (grammatical term); also "highest grade" in some contexts
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧ — first-rate, top-tier (focuses on prestige and reputation)
